description: How the hedge fund keeps optimizing itself, as a cybernetic loop — senses (daily attribute vectors), brain (the neural network retrained daily), reflexes (lever changes gated by backtests, reverted when worse), growth (new funds and legs proposed), immune system (fail-closed guards), memory (the outcome ledger) — each stage with TODAY's live number and where to see it, and whether it is measurably getting stronger (a flat or falling trend is said plainly). Quote its numbers; never claim improvement it does not show. (no key needed)
name: tuatara_how_it_evolves
title: Tuatara How It Evolves
